test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

1. stray dog entered the school gate.

P: The children ran away in fear.

Q: It started barking loudly.

R: A peon chased it away.

S: Some teachers came out of the staff room.

6. Order was soon restored.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes an event involving a stray dog entering a school and the sequence of actions that follow.
 
• **Part Q is the first sentence** as it describes the dog's initial action:
 
 
• "It started barking loudly."
 
 
 
• **Part P follows** as it describes the reaction of the children to the dog's barking:
 
 
• "The children ran away in fear."
 
 
 
• **Part S comes next** as it introduces the teachers' involvement:
 
 
• "Some teachers came out of the staff room."
 
 
 
• **Part R concludes** as it describes the resolution of the situation:
 
 
• "A peon chased it away."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **QPSR**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"A stray dog entered the school gate. It started barking loudly. The children ran away in fear. Some teachers came out of the staff room. A peon chased it away. Order was soon restored."
